notes.title: Update Highlights: Soul Bag, Visual Polish & Steam Cloud Support
notes.content:
[h1]Update Highlights: Soul Bag, Steam Cloud, Visual Tweaks & Fixes[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621662/7d987dc38dd2c29a12ec7957185fec9bec472c96.gif[/img]
[i]Weather upgrade[/i]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621662/f72188b5b697d90de0ce535e6dd73cc4df92f81a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621662/976a02f7283a3e514d9599d1f90b1211e1d4f2cc.png[/img][/url]
[i]New NPC: Spectral Demon[/i]

[h2]New Features & Improvements[/h2]
🌧️ [b]Weather Upgrades[/b]: Rain and snow have been redesigned to look more immersive and blend naturally into the world.  
🗃️ [b]Steam Cloud Saves[/b]: Your progress is now safely synced with Steam Cloud! Jump between machines without losing your adventure.  
🎮 [b]Manual FPS Limit[/b]: You can now manually set a maximum FPS from the options menu, giving you better control over performance.  
🌐 [b]Instant Language Change[/b]: Switching languages now applies instantly—no need to hit "Save" or restart the game.  
🔔 [b]Smoother Notifications[/b]: Notifications now appear neatly at the top right and have been fully reworked for clarity and speed.  
📜 [b]Enhanced Dialogues[/b]: Campaign 1’s first quest has been improved with better-written lines and subtle text animations to convey emotions.  
👻 [b]Soul Bag[/b]: A new quest item that lets you collect demon souls. These souls will be used to unlock sealed gates that lead to boss dungeons.  
💡 [b]Floating Player Hints[/b]: New optional setting that reinforces warnings like "movement blocked" when managing inventory or skills.

[h2]Visual & UI Tweaks[/h2]  
🎬 [b]Credits screen[/b].  
✨ [b]Soul Collection FX[/b]: Added special effects when collecting demon souls to make the moment more satisfying.  
📝 [b]Minor UI polish[/b] (e.g., opening chests now shows the correct localized text).

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]  
⚖️ [b]Starting Items Adjusted[/b]: Attribute and skill recovery potions are no longer included in Campaign mode. They remain available when starting in Survival mode.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]  
🐞 Fixed: You could sharpen a weapon even if none was equipped.  
👀 Fixed: Combat effects from distant zones were sometimes visible when they shouldn't be.


[h3]Thanks![/h3]
